Proposition
[Fibrewise Uniqueness of the Density]

↗ def:density-vector-space ↗ prop:density-transformation-law ↗ prop:density-value-one

If $\mu $ is a density on an inner product space and $\mu (e_1,\ldots ,e_n)=1$ on an orthonormal basis, then $\mu (v_1,\ldots ,v_n)=|v_1\wedge \cdots \wedge v_n|$ for all $v_i$.

Proof

↗ prop:density-transformation-law ↗ prop:density-value-one \sketch Let $f$ be the linear map with $fe_i=v_i$. Both the density transformation law for $\mu $ and Proposition 9, together with the value $1$ on $(e_i)$, give $|\det f|$.

□
